history.summary: At the $1,488,888 ask ($2,065 psf) this 721 sqft 2BR is fairly priced and sits inside the 2026 transacted band ($2,059-$2,131 psf for the 720-743 sqft cluster) — but it is NOT the best-value unit in its own development. A near-identical 721 sqft twin (listing 60147887) is listed ~$9k cheaper, and a larger 743 sqft 2BR is on the market at $1,992 psf for roughly the same ~$1.48M total. Fundamentals are sound (UOL, 797 units, 5-min walk to Bartley MRT, ~88yr lease) but gross yield is only ~3.1% and there is no fresh catalyst. Neutral at the ask; a Buy at ~$1.42-1.45M with floor/facing confirmed.
history.rating_rationale: (1) Fair, not cheap: $2,065 psf is mid-band vs Jan-May 2026 transactions ($2,059-$2,131 psf for ~720-743 sqft) — you are paying market, not below it. (2) Two better-value live alternatives exist in the SAME project: a same-size 721 sqft twin ~$9k cheaper and a LARGER 743 sqft unit at $1,992 psf (~$73 psf less) for similar money — so there is no relative reason to take this exact unit at ask. (3) Yield is only ~3.1-3.2% gross, below the 4% bar at this price. (4) Held up by genuine strengths — UOL build quality, 797-unit liquidity, real 5-min MRT walk, healthy ~88yr lease — which is why this is Neutral, not Avoid. Flips to Buy if negotiated to ~$1.42-1.45M and the stack/floor/facing check out.

history.summary: Own-stay evaluation of a 721 sqft 2BR (converted Flexi) at Botanique at Bartley, asking $1,488,888 with agent-indicated nego floor of $1.45M ($2,011 psf). Physical viewing CONFIRMED the development's known red flag: loud expressway (PIE/Upper Paya Lebar Rd) noise — this unit is on a road-facing stack. Unit is well maintained with ID done (incl. custom cat carpentry). Fairly priced at $1.45M but not a bargain once the confirmed noise defect is priced in; better-value alternatives exist in the same development.
history.rating_rationale: The prior evaluation (3 days ago) rated this exact listing Neutral at ask, upgradeable to Buy at $1.42-1.45M *with floor/facing confirmed* — the viewing resolved that condition NEGATIVELY: noise is 'quite loud'. At $1.45M ($2,011 psf) the price sits ~2-5% below the 2026 transacted band for this size cluster ($2,059-2,131 psf) — a real discount, but roughly equal to the standard noisy-facing discount, so you are paying fair value for a defective facing, not getting a deal. For OWN-STAY the noise is a daily quality-of-life tax (windows closed permanently, balcony of limited use — resident reviews echo this) and the same discount will be demanded by your future buyer on exit. Offsets: ID done + well maintained saves ~$50-80k and months of reno; 5-min walk to Bartley MRT; liquid 797-unit UOL development. Net: Neutral at $1.45M. Becomes a defensible own-stay buy at ~$1.40-1.42M ($1,942-1,970 psf), where the noise is genuinely priced in — or skip to a quieter inner stack / the 743 sqft comp at $1,992 psf.

At $1.45M ($2,011 psf) the price sits ~2-5% below the 2026 transacted band for this size cluster ($2,059-2,131 psf) — a real discount, but roughly equal to the standard noisy-facing discount, so you are paying fair value for a defective facing, not getting a deal. For OWN-STAY the noise is a daily quality-of-life tax (windows closed permanently, balcony of limited use — resident reviews echo this) and the same discount will be demanded by your future buyer on exit. Offsets: ID done + well maintained saves ~$50-80k and months of reno; 5-min walk to Bartley MRT; liquid 797-unit UOL development. Net: Neutral at $1.45M. Becomes a defensible own-stay buy at ~$1.40-1.42M ($1,942-1,970 psf), where the noise is genuinely priced in — or skip to a quieter inner stack / the 743 sqft comp at $1,992 psf.

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Secondary for own-stay, but relevant as fallback optionality: 2BR at Botanique realistically rents $3,800-4,000/mo (algo's $2,884 district-average estimate is too low for this project), giving ~3.2% gross at $1.45M — below the 4% bar. Tenant demand is steady (Bartley MRT, quiet enclave) but a noisy unit also rents at a discount and churns tenants faster.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: URA D19 5yr CAGR is 5.3% (264 transactions, high confidence) but that includes the 2021-2023 boom; post-2023 the pace has cooled. Development is at an all-time-high psf in 2026 ($2,176 avg, $2,407 peak) with no fresh catalyst (Circle Line already operational, no new MRT or transformation zone). Realistic forward rate ~4-4.5%/yr for the project — and road-facing stacks historically lag the development average. Entry at $2,011 psf (below the $2,059-2,131 band) provides some buffer.
agent_evaluation.stack_notes: Visit-confirmed: this unit is on a noisy road/expressway-facing stack — exactly the stacks the prior development-level evaluation said to avoid. The stacks to target at Botanique are the inner, landscape/garden-facing ones away from Upper Paya Lebar Rd and Bartley Rd. If own-stay comfort is the priority, viewing a quieter inner-stack 2BR (e.g. the 743 sqft at $1,992 psf) before committing is the single highest-value next step. Mitigation if proceeding: budget ~$10-20k for secondary/soundproof glazing (check MCST rules) and assume windows stay closed (higher aircon bills).
